name: project-scaffolder
description: A strictly sequential, multi-agent way to build a product with Claude Code: questions-only brainstorm, a Karpathy-style second brain with project skills, agents and a never-published secrets folder, design-system-first artboards with anti-slop and measured accessibility critique saved as Artifact pages, a build pipeline with a bug hunt after every task, and 1 to 100 verification rounds before every release. Improvement and research loops run as plugin workflows. Model routing is binding: Fable plans and verifies, Opus builds, Sonnet re-checks and mass-tests.
